title: 第9章 有小人告状第10章 这可由不得你
content_zh:
靠，有小人告状。
他才来天牢当差多久啊，就碍了某些人的眼，在背后打小报告。
他自问做人还算圆滑，做事也算踏实，不嫌累不嫌脏，竟然还有人看他不顺眼偷偷打小报告。这些人的心啊，就如罗敬天说的那样，特么的没一个好人，全都是黑心烂肠子的玩意。抓起来挨个砍头，没有一个是冤枉的。
“许叔，你是看着我长大的，我是什么样的人，别人不清楚，你肯定清楚。说我给犯人带吃带喝，我不否认。大牢里面所有人都这么干。说我往外传递消息，我是死也不认。我刚来第一天，你的教导还历历在目，我是时刻谨记在心，不该犯的规矩，我是坚守底线绝不触犯。我是你的人，我犯了事，就是给许叔你制造麻烦，我岂是这等忘恩负义之辈。不知道究竟是什么样的人，什么样的歹毒用心，竟然编排谣言。许叔，这是有人试图通过我来攻击你啊！不可不防！”
许富贵表情复杂的看着陈观楼，臭小子嘴巴挺能说的啊！
他沉默不言，似乎是在考量话中几分真几分假，又像是在考虑这件事的后果。想起陈观楼来天牢后的表现，刚拿到俸禄第一时间给他送礼，又是喝酒又是勾栏听曲，年纪轻轻就很懂事。为人也算厚道，比起那帮老油条，清澈得甚至有点愚蠢。
转眼的功夫，许富贵似乎有了主张，“我当然信你做不出串通内外的事情，但是，劫狱那晚，你是唯一的活口，难免有人私下里叽叽歪歪。这回的事情，摆明了有人要搞你，最近你最好低调些，不要硬出头。有什么事，及时告诉我，不要擅作主张。”
“多谢许叔，我一定谨记许叔的教诲。”
“如此甚好！好好当差吧，他们非要冤枉你，我肯定不答应。”
许富贵拍拍陈观楼的肩膀，离开了食堂。
陈观楼却出了一身冷汗，不是因为许富贵，而是因为他刚意识到鬼域门劫狱那晚，值房的人都死光了，就活了他一个，显然他已经成了某些人眼中的靶子。
明明上面已经不追究了，偏偏天牢这边有人非要逮着事情不放，想搞把大的，典型的损人不利己。
特么的，这么做分明是犯众怒。
他找到卢大头，将事情一说。卢大头皱起眉头想了想，突然拍着大腿，骂了一句国粹，“肯定是张万通那个杂碎。”
“张万通，我可没得罪过他。”
“老弟啊，你新来，不了解情况。张万通别看表面上大大咧咧，看起来大方，其实最记仇最小气的人。上次，你帮我回本，那晚张万通输得连底裤都没保住，肯定记恨在心。他不敢动我，他敢动我，劳资白刀子进红刀子出。但你是新人，他这是盯上你了。不过你也不用担心，我去帮你说和。没他这么做事的，必须好好跟他说道说道。”
“肯定是他吗？”
“除了他不会有别人。”卢大头十分肯定。
陈观楼半信半疑，先让卢大头去试探一二。他想不通，张万通能这么智障。
不知道卢大头是怎么跟张万通说的，反正张万通见到他后，是一脸的心虚。

陈观楼：……
还真是张万通这厮打小报告啊！
就因为他帮卢大头回本，这么点小事，就记恨上他。靠，小人一个！这笔账先记下。
……
罗敬天被带走了，受了重刑。
两日后被送回天牢，是被人拖着回来的，一地的血痕，皮开肉绽，全身上下没有一块好肉。真是惨不忍睹。
陈观楼偷偷给了他一碗吊命的稀饭。
content_en:
Damn, someone is complaining.
He had only been working in Tianlao for a long time, but he was already in the eyes of some people and was making snitches behind their backs.
He asked himself that he was quite tactful and down-to-earth in his work. He was neither tired nor dirty, but there were still people who disliked him and secretly reported him. The hearts of these people, just like Luo Jingtian said, none of them are good people, they are all black-hearted and rotten things. They were arrested and beheaded one by one, and no one was unjust.
"Uncle Xu, you have watched me grow up. What kind of person I am, others don't know, but you must know it. I don't deny that I bring food and drink to the prisoners. Everyone in the prison does this. If you say that I pass on news to the outside world, I will not deny it even to death. On the first day I came here, your teachings are still vivid in my mind. I always keep them in mind. No. I will stick to the bottom line and never violate the rules. I am yours, and I am just causing trouble for you, Uncle Xu. How can I be such an ungrateful person? I don’t know what kind of person I am, and what kind of evil intentions I have to fabricate rumors. Uncle Xu, this is someone trying to attack you through me!"
Xu Fugui looked at Chen Guanlou with a complicated expression. The brat is very talkative!
He remained silent, seeming to be considering the truth and falsehood of his words, and also seemed to be considering the consequences of this matter. Thinking of Chen Guanlou's behavior after coming to Tianlao, he gave him gifts as soon as he got his salary, drank wine and listened to music. He was very sensible at a young age. He is also kind-hearted, and compared to those old fritters, he is clear-minded and even a little stupid.
In the blink of an eye, Xu Fugui seemed to have an idea, "Of course I believe you can't do anything to collude with others. However, on the night of the prison robbery, you were the only one alive, so it was inevitable that someone would gossip in private. This time, it is clear that someone is trying to mess with you. You'd better keep a low profile recently and don't stand out. If anything happens, tell me in time and don't make arbitrary decisions."
"Thank you Uncle Xu. I will definitely remember Uncle Xu's teachings."
"That's very good! Do your job well. If they insist on unjustly accusing you, I will definitely not agree."
Xu Fugui patted Chen Guanlou on the shoulder and left the canteen.
Chen Guanlou broke out in a cold sweat, not because of Xu Fugui, but because he had just realized that on the night of the prison robbery at Guiyumen, all the people on duty were dead, and he was the only one left alive. Obviously, he had become a target in the eyes of some people.
Obviously the higher authorities are no longer pursuing the matter, but there are people here in Tianlao who insist on catching the matter and want to make a big deal out of it. This is a typical case of harming others but not benefiting oneself.
What the hell, doing this is clearly an outrage.
He found Lu Datou and talked about the matter. Lu Datou frowned and thought for a while, then suddenly slapped his thigh and cursed the quintessence of Chinese culture, "It must be that bastard Zhang Wantong."
"Zhang Wantong, I have never offended him."
"Brother, you are new here and don't understand the situation. Although Zhang Wantong looks carefree and generous on the surface, he is actually the most grudge-y and stingy person. Last time, you helped me get my money back. Zhang Wantong lost and didn't even keep his underwear that night. He must have a grudge. He doesn't dare to touch me. If he dares to touch me, the labor will come in and the red knife will come out. But you are a newcomer and he is targeting you. But you don't have to worry. I will help you make peace with him. You must talk to him properly. "
"Is it definitely him?"
"There will be no one else except him." Lu Datou was very sure.
Chen Guanlou was dubious and asked Lu Datou to test it first. He couldn't understand how Zhang Wantong could be so mentally retarded.
I don’t know what Lu Datou told Zhang Wantong, but Zhang Wantong looked guilty after seeing him.
Chen Guanlou:......
It’s really Zhang Wantong’s snitching!
Just because he helped Lu Datou repay his money, for such a trivial matter, he hated him. Damn, what a villain! Write down this account first.
…
Luo Jingtian was taken away and severely tortured.
Two days later, he was sent back to the prison, where he was dragged back. There were bloodstains all over the ground, and his skin and flesh were torn.There is not a good piece of meat in the whole body. It's really terrible.
Chen Guanlou secretly gave him a bowl of porridge to kill him.
